//: Global CoC config. Drop this at ~/.vim/coc-settings.json (create the ~/.vim folder if it doesn't exist yet). C, C++, Python and Rust are handled by dedicated coc extensions installed via setup.sh (coc-clangd, coc-pyright, coc-rust-analyzer) and need no entry here. Haskell and MATLAB have no official coc extension, so they're wired up below as plain LSP servers.
